policy.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical sorted-key compact JSON

precision_controls.metric_scope: Gate decisions are per tensor and step. gradient_all_parameters and update_all_parameters concatenate the role across all parameters for that step; they do not replace individual tensor gates. Failed reason counts can overlap within one gate.

loss_reporting_note.interpretation: Consistent with a scalar-division rounding difference; the denominator operation was not independently isolated on GPU.

layer_diagnostics.lineage: Probes instrumented preceding control implementations. The separate public-to-prior comparisons above connect those observations to the public controls; BF16 reference losses differ at two steps, so full public-reference equality is not claimed.

rope_cpu_diagnostic.inputs: each side own captured Q/K after normalization

hf_reproduction.formula: BF16 coefficients, BF16-rounded products, BF16-rounded sum

rope_cpu_diagnostic.interpretation: Consistent with coefficient and intermediate-rounding differences at RoPE; not proof of native kernel or backward correctness.
limits: CPU transcendental and fused GPU arithmetic need not match bitwise.
Runtime RoPE coefficient buffers were not captured.

rope_gpu_diagnostic.purpose: altered reference arithmetic diagnostic only; not a replacement acceptance oracle
rope_gpu_diagnostic.change: HF RoPE cos/sin and split-half multiply/add in FP32, final cast to original Q/K dtype

limits: All three completed public controls remain numerical_failure under the original policy.
Autocast with FP32 parameters is not the same precision contract as a BF16-parameter model.
BF16 autograd gradients can round before FP32 accumulation; these controls do not reproduce Transformer Engine fused wgrad.
This single-GPU dense fixture does not establish correctness across parallel configurations or other models.

backend_controls.scope: Four paired tiny Qwen3 MoE GPU controls, three planned optimizer steps per run; experimental backend ownership patch.

cpu_checks.scope: CPU classification and synthetic buffer geometry; separate from real GPU controls.
